spain.original:
Donde hay amigos,
hay alegría sin fin,
como en la familia.
spain.translation:
Where there are friends,
there is endless joy,
like in a family.
spain.author: Spanish proverb

thai.original:
เพื่อนที่ดี
เหมือนเงาอบอุ่น
เดินเคียงข้างกัน
thai.translation:
A good friend
is like a warm shadow,
walking by your side.
thai.author: Thai saying

russia.original:
Без семьи
и солнце не светит —
жизнь темна.
russia.translation:
Without family,
even the sun does not shine—
life is dark.
russia.author: Russian proverb

ethiopia.original:
ወዳጅ ሰው
እንደ ወንድም ነው፣
ልብን ይሞቅልናል።
ethiopia.translation:
A true friend
is like a brother,
he warms the heart.
ethiopia.author: Amharic proverb

nz.original:
He tangata, he tangata,
he tangata.
Ko te mea nui.
nz.translation:
It is people, it is people,
it is people.
That is what matters most.
nz.author: Māori proverb (Whakataukī)

philipines.original:
Ang pamilya ay tahanan,
ang kaibigan ay kalinga,
parehong kayamanan.
philipines.translation:
Family is a home,
friends are care,
both are treasures.
philipines.author: Tagalog saying

png.original:
Ol wantok,
ol famili,
spes bilong yumi.
png.translation:
Our wantoks,
our family,
are our strength.
png.author: Tok Pisin proverb

sweden.original:
Vänner vid bordet,
ljuset blir varmare,
hemmet känns helt.
sweden.translation:
Friends at the table,
the light grows warmer,
home feels complete.
sweden.author: Swedish verse

germany.original:
Freunde sind Familie,
die man selbst wählt,
Herz an Herz.
germany.translation:
Friends are family,
that we choose ourselves,
heart to heart.
germany.author: German saying

netherlands.original:
Vrienden lachen samen,
zoals wind door tulpen—
vrolijk en vrij.
netherlands.translation:
Friends laugh together,
like wind through tulips—
cheerful and free.
netherlands.author: Dutch verse

uk.original:
Home is where
kind hearts gather,
never apart.
uk.translation:
Home is where
kind hearts gather,
never apart.
uk.author: English proverb

srilanka.original:
කുടුඹය සුරක්ෂිතයි,
මිතුරන් සතුට ගෙනෙයි—
ජීවිතය සම්පූර්ණයි.
srilanka.translation:
Family gives safety,
friends bring joy—
life is complete.
srilanka.author: Sinhala verse

switzerland.original:
Freundschaft wie Berge,
steht stark im Sturm,
bleibt ewig.
switzerland.translation:
Friendship like mountains,
stands strong in storms,
remains forever.
switzerland.author: Swiss German verse

finland.original:
Ystävä on tuli,
joka lämmittää sydäntä,
talven kylmyydessä.
finland.translation:
A friend is a fire,
that warms the heart,
in the winter’s cold.
finland.author: Finnish proverb

hk.original:
朋友如茶，
共飲方香甜，
暖心長久。
hk.translation:
Friends are like tea,
sweeter when shared,
warming the heart forever.
hk.author: Cantonese verse

saudi.original:
الصديق الوفي
نعمة من الله،
يبقى للأبد.
saudi.translation:
A loyal friend
is a blessing from God,
lasting forever.
saudi.author: Arabic proverb

afghanistan.original:
دوست صادق
همچون برادر است،
همیشه با تو.
afghanistan.translation:
A true friend
is like a brother,
always with you.
afghanistan.author: Dari proverb

colombia2.original:
La familia es raíz,
los amigos son alas,
vida completa.
colombia2.translation:
Family is the root,
friends are the wings,
life is complete.
colombia2.author: Colombian saying

france.original:
Famille unie,
force infinie,
coeur tranquille.
france.translation:
A united family,
infinite strength,
a peaceful heart.
france.author: French proverb

india2.original:
सच्चा मित्र
जीवन का धन है,
सदा संग रहता।
india2.translation:
A true friend
is life’s treasure,
always stays with you.
india2.author: Hindi proverb

japan_lunch.original:
友と共に
食卓を囲み
春の光。
japan_lunch.translation:
With friends together,
around the table,
in spring’s light.
japan_lunch.author: Japanese haiku style

south_sudan.original:
Family is life,
friendship is peace,
we walk together.
south_sudan.translation:
Family is life,
friendship is peace,
we walk together.
south_sudan.author: South Sudanese proverb
